title: ThreeSceneAdapter
responsibility: Create a native Three.js scene with dimensional cameras and a software fallback when WebGL is unavailable.

inputs.name: ThreeSceneAdapter.constructor.canvas
inputs.description: Canvas used as the WebGL renderer target. Its width and height set the renderer size and initial camera aspect, and the constructor writes renderer metadata to dataset.

inputs.name: ThreeSceneAdapter.constructor.context
inputs.description: Existing WebGL2 context passed to the Three.js renderer with antialiasing enabled. The constructor uses the supplied context; create3d performs context lookup and selects the software adapter when lookup returns null.

inputs.name: ThreeSceneAdapter.render.run
inputs.description: Current game run passed into render. This adapter reads run.state: x and y are converted with Number, while hasKey, doorOpen, and strict-false visible:* values control the player, key, and door meshes.

inputs.name: ThreeSceneAdapter.render.view
inputs.description: Current view selects camera mode and whether an authored world layout is displayed. Only dimension '2d' selects the orthographic camera; a truthy world hides the legacy ground, door, and key and renders the authored layout.

inputs.name: create3d.canvas
inputs.description: Canvas on which create3d requests a WebGL2 context with antialiasing enabled. The function returns Software3dAdapter when lookup returns null and ThreeSceneAdapter when it returns a context.

outputs.name: ThreeSceneAdapter.render
outputs.description: Synchronously updates mesh positions and visibility from run.state, renders the legacy scene or authored world with the selected camera, then sets the canvas dimension and readiness dataset values.

outputs.name: ThreeSceneAdapter.dispose
outputs.description: Disposes geometry and materials for every mesh in the scene, then disposes the Three.js renderer.

outputs.name: create3d
outputs.description: A FrameSource exposing the canvas, render, and dispose operations. It is a ThreeSceneAdapter when the canvas returns a WebGL2 context and a Software3dAdapter when lookup returns null.

inputs.description: Canvas used as the WebGL renderer target. Its width and height set the renderer size and initial camera aspect, and the constructor writes renderer metadata to dataset.

outputs.description: The constructed ThreeSceneAdapter instance, with its renderer, flat and perspective cameras, lights, legacy meshes, and world group initialized in the scene.
